links.comparator_used: Fully manual annotation of PII without model preannotation (same annotator, same 200 notes split into 10 rounds)
links.outcome: Annotation time and annotation accuracy (PII tagging) against a gold standard
links.effect: Time for 5 rounds ~58 min with preannotation vs ~98 min without; 43% faster (95% CI 33.9-52.1; P<.001). Overall micro-average recall higher by 0.013 (0.9886 vs 0.9756) and F1 higher by 0.0053 (0.9922 vs 0.9869).
links.tradeoff: Preannotation had a few false negative and false positive errors on PHONE (F1 0.9667 vs 1) and ADDRESS (F1 0.9231 vs 1). Overall precision was slightly lower (0.9958 vs 0.9985). The model was a BiLSTM-CRF with RoBERTa embeddings, not an LLM. A single annotator did the work, and rounds were not randomized (the first 5 were without preannotation, the last 5 with).
links.quote: Using preannotation during the manual annotation process resulted in a time savings of 43% and a micro- F 1 -score improvement of 0.005 compared to manual annotation performed without preannotation.
